_doc: The sensitive paths of this repository (docs/spec/08-configuration.md rule 5), copied to .github/review-paths.json and named by [review] sensitive_paths. The bridge reads it at each PR's base, so a PR cannot weaken the list that judges it; release-cut reads it at the candidate to compute the release class. A changed path is sensitive when it matches a glob (`*` and `**` also cross `/`, `?` is one character, `[seq]` a class) or lies under the directory a glob names (`a/**`, `a/*` and `a/` all cover everything below `a/`). `paths` must be a non-empty list: an empty one would make nothing sensitive, and is refused. Every key other than `paths` is documentation and is ignored.
_doc_paths: Replace the examples with what merges, publishes, deploys, handles a credential or changes who may do what. Keep this file itself in the list.
_doc_exceptions: A path that looks sensitive but is deliberately left out of `paths`, each as {"path": "...", "reason": "..."} with a reason a reviewer can check.
